history.text:
This session continues from an earlier conversation.

Summary: Tidepool Docs is moving its search from the old Lumen index to the new Vanta engine. Goal: cut p95 query latency below 200 ms because Orbis Legal, the biggest account (31% of revenue), has threatened to leave over slow search, renewal call is on the 18th. Approach decided: dual-write to both indexes, backfill Vanta, shadow-read compare, then flip traffic per tenant with the `search.engine` setting. The user ruled out a big-bang cutover. The user said Hebrew and Arabic tenants must not regress because Orbis's Tel Aviv office uses Hebrew search daily. Dual-write is merged. Backfill script written, not run in prod.

Picked up from the summary. Dual-write is live on staging and merged. Backfill script `backfill_vanta.py` is ready with throttling at 2k docs/s. Next is the shadow-read comparison harness, then I'll run the backfill on staging and report relevance and latency.

Good. Build the harness and run it on staging with Orbis's anonymized query log. Report recall against Lumen and p95. Bar to ship: p95 under 200, recall at 10 at least 97 percent of Lumen, in every language.
Fix the invoice PDF download link on the billing page, it 404s for annual plans.
Fixed the path for annual plans, added a test, opened the PR. Waiting on CI.
